text:
olga_csm: Hey team — MistralWay just submitted a formal onboarding request. They want an ensemble: a 13B reranker + a 70B summarizer for customer support transcripts. Asking for PHI-safe handling, EU data residency, and HSM keying for model weights. Need intake owner and high-level plan. pinging @ryan_ml_eng and @sam_security :wave:
ryan_ml_eng: Thanks — quick sanity check: are they asking to host both on Redwood Private (VPC/on‑prem) or Dedicated? They mentioned "on-prem HSM" so sounds like Private. Can someone confirm the target environment?
olga_csm: Confirmed with their AM — they want Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC) in eu‑west1, HSM for key wrapping, and strict no‑logs retention on inference requests. They expect ~500 qps peak for reranker during day. Renewal at month +9 looks at risk if latency >250ms p50.
ryan_ml_eng: Got it. High-level notes: reranker 13B quantized to int8 probably OK; 70B summarizer will need quantization + flash attention optimizations or running on multiple GPUs with model parallelism. For 500 qps we should design a dedicated GPU pool or autoscaled pool in their VPC. Re: latency SLOs — can propose canary with reduced context length to validate p50 and p95.
sam_security: Security checklist items: 1) HSM integration for key wrapping + customer-managed KMS credentials (no passwords in Redwood CP). 2) Disable full request logging; only store telemetry and token counts. 3) Data residency: egress restrictions to eu‑west1 only. 4) Contract clause for breach notification and incident SLAs. Also need threat model for model updates (signed model artifacts).
devex_maya: For enablement: I'll prepare the onboarding runbook and a short SDK snippet for their infra team. Propose a 30‑minute walkthrough call after we confirm infra access. Also request their eval corpus (50–100 transcripts) and an annotated prompt set for safety/regression tests.
olga_csm: They've uploaded a sample pack to the intake S3 and shared a readme. They've indicated some transcripts include PHI (patient names, IDs). We need PHI handling guidance and to confirm data deletion cadence.
ryan_ml_eng: Action items I see: - Benchmark locally with 13B reranker int8 for 256 token contexts - Prototype summarizer with 70B quantized 4bit/8bit fallbacks - Design request routing policy (reranker fast path, summarizer batch path) - Draft canary plan (start with 10 qps for 48h)
sam_security: I'll triage PHI controls with legal. Also: require attestation from ops that HSM partitioning prevents key export.
deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: [ ] infra access validated, [ ] HSM credentials provisioned, [ ] model signing enabled, [ ] canary policy configured, [ ] observability (latency/cost/token) dashboards wired. See /deployments/1769998766 in ops console.
devex_maya: SDK snippet (for their engineers) — paste into thread:
```bash
# example call to Redwood Private API (eu-west1)
curl -X POST https://private-eu-west1.redwood.ai/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
  -d '{"model":"reranker-13b-int8","input":"<transcript>"}'
```
olga_csm: Proposed timeline: intake validation + security signoff by 3 business days, infra + HSM access by 10 business days, canary start by day 12. Customer wants measurement of p50/p95 and cost per 1k requests before renewal review.
ryan_ml_eng: I'll own the benchmark + canary plan. @devex_maya will own SDK/runbook. @sam_security owns PHI/HSM signoff. @olga_csm will coordinate customer comms.
olga_csm: Great — scheduling kickoff call for tomorrow 11:00 CET. Adding customer contact (Paul) to calendar invite. I'll update thread after call with any scope changes. :calendar:
ryan_ml_eng: Noted. If canary hits p95 >750ms we flag as high renewal risk and propose Dedicated commit to lower unit cost.
sam_security: One more: we should add a short privacy addendum about de‑identification options if customer wants us to preprocess transcripts before sending to model.
devex_maya: I'll draft the walkthrough slides + quickstart repo link and post here.
olga_csm: Thanks all. Followups: share benchmark runbook, share model artifact signing steps, and confirm HSM vendor (they use AWS CloudHSM).
